title: Concept: Package.resolved pin with no version
description: Package.resolved declares a resolved pin that records only a revision, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a resolved pin that records only a revision.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Package.resolved (swift).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a resolved pin that records only a revision.
